def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t1.unfold(0, 1, 2)
    idx2 = torch.tensor([1], device=t1.device)
    t1.index_fill_(0, idx2, 0)
    t1[1:, :] = t1[:-1, :].clone()
    v3 = v1.neg()
    t0.add_(t0.flip(1))
    v4 = v3[:, 8:10:2, 0]
    v1.masked_fill_(v3 > 0, 5)
    idx5 = torch.tensor([1, 0], device=t2.device)
    t2.index_copy_(2, idx5, t0.narrow(2, 0, 2))
    return (v4, t0, v4, lst, dct)
